COLDWAR_COL_has_regional_network = {
	# IMPERIA COLD WAR — guard: var: scopes only with a valid state id (error-log fix 01.11.2026)
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_support_target check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target < 5000 } }
		has_intelligence_agency = yes
		network_strength = { state = var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target value > 50 }
	}
	else = { always = no }
}

	controller = { ROOT = { NOT = { is_subject_of = PREV } } }
	COLDWAR_COL_contact_state = yes
}
